newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly down, Sep up on mills.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly down, Sep up on mills.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly lower on fund and commission house selling but mill buying interest late lifted the September, traders said.
"It was another big day of pretty good selling, both intermarket spreads and outright," a trader said. "We saw commission and fund selling with light scale-down buying."
Benson Quinn reportedly sold 3.5 million bushels December on the day, traders said. Light speculative short-covering was also noted, they said.
Traders said poor export demand continued to stifle attempts at a rally.
News Tunisia had bought 175,000 tonnes soft wheat on Thursday underlined the fact U.S. wheat was overvalued compared to world prices, they said.
Wheat ended 1-1/4 cent per bushel higher to seven cents lower with September up 1-1/4 at $4.57.
Barley futures were slightly firmer in very thin trade.
"Barley found a home because the cash market is right around where the board is," a trader said. "We're at a point where we might start to see some buying interest."
Barley ended one to two cents per cwt higher with September unchanged at $7.40.
